role_boundary.rule: Chat performs provenance classification, strategy, substantive editing/writing, discourse judgment, and semantic adjudication. Codex may verify, transport exact prompts/results, hash, store, and run deterministic syntax/provenance checks only.

source.changed_scope: The four Introduction prose paragraphs after # Introduction and before ## Your Physical State Can Change What Therapy Does.

authorized_reasoning_scope.stop_before_exact_heading: ## Your Physical State Can Change What Therapy Does

provenance_spans.authority_note: Heading is outside the prose repair target and must remain exact.
Current direct owner instruction classifies the four prose paragraphs as the bounded AI-written repair target. This operational class does not credit retained wording as owner-Human evidence.
Exact stop heading and all later material are outside scope.

strategy.generation_rule: No complete-section regeneration and no semantic inventory is given to the writer. Cycle 1 allows source-only deletion, intact relocation, paragraph-boundary changes, and mechanically required punctuation/capitalization, with zero new lexical tokens.
strategy.primary_signal: Blind discourse movement and owner judgment; not Pangram.

cycle_budget.cycle_2_rule: Allowed only after a mechanically valid first candidate and only for one exact topology interaction or one deleted protected function. At most one exact source span may become a new non-deletable lock.

blockers: No fresh source-bound writer result exists.
No two independent blind-motion verdicts exist.

detector.policy: detector unavailable during prose-design experiment; any later call must use an exact whole-document candidate and separate authority

family_killed_if: new lexical prose or paraphrase is introduced
both blind readers locate the same remaining visible-plan defect and no source-only topology change remains
a blind-shape survivor loses or changes more than one protected function
cycle 2 repeats the same earliest visible-plan defect
semantic completion would require two or more new constraints or new connective prose
the owner rejects an internally admitted candidate as still obviously AI-shaped
detector output is used to choose an edit
